name: DDinosaur with Double D's
source:
DDinosaur has felt alone for millions of years now... Will she be able to find love without revealing her biggest secret? That she's a Dinosaur...with double D's.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2473890]Steam[/url]]
translation:
恐龙已经感受了数百万年的孤独……她能在不泄露自己最大秘密的情况下找到爱情吗？她是一只恐龙……有双D。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2473890]Steam[/url]]
